title: Home
---

This site ships `theme: darkly` and nothing else: one presentation, and it is
dark-coloured. The rendered page carries a single `id="quarto-bootstrap"` link
tagged `data-mode="dark"`, no colour-scheme toggle and no before-body script —
a visually dark page that every declaration-level signal calls light.

```{=html}
<!-- PLANTED: button-name (critical). One deliberate finding, so the single
     'default' cell demonstrably scanned this page rather than an about:blank
     lookalike. -->
<p><button></button></p>
```

Keep this page's markup minimal. Its concern is mode discovery and the
dark-coloured annotation, not findings.
